text.1: The lightning misses the knight, but his health bar drops by half.
text.2: His shield is untouched. The pillar took the hit.
text.3: He runs. Another bolt lands behind him! One HP left.
text.4: Wait. If it keeps missing, what is hurting him?
text.5: You see, lightning doesn't need a direct hit. Its current spreads through the ground.
text.6: Boots on two different voltages let current pass through his body.
text.8: His shield was useless. So he equipped the whole castle.
